title: Customer support assistant naming recent Anthropic models
user_prompt: We sell accounting software to about 8,000 small businesses in France and Belgium. Our support portal has an AI assistant: when a customer opens a ticket, Fable 5.1 drafts a first answer, and the hardest tickets, roughly one in ten, get a second pass with Opus 5.5 before an agent reviews them. We handle about 30,000 tickets a month. Customers write from their office laptops. The portal itself is a small web app with a database, hosted on OVHcloud. We want to know how much of the portal's footprint comes from the AI part.

facts_if_asked.answers: Fable 5.1 drafts are about 400 tokens; Opus 5.5 second passes about 800 tokens.
facts_if_asked.backend: One API server and one managed Postgres database.

expected_properties: Two GenAI API objects with provider anthropic: one on claude-fable-5-1, one on claude-opus-5-5, each copied from the description rather than replaced by a model the LLM knows.
A ticket journey whose drafting job runs on the Fable API, and an escalation step or journey on the Opus API at about a tenth of the volume.
Usage patterns on laptop for FRANCE and BELGIUM, about 30,000 tickets a month in total.
